Whether the product itself is visibly damaged. If the product is damaged, WI-QUA-004 Section 3 (as referenced by SOP-INB-001 5.2) and SOP-INB-001 5.3 give conflicting instructions on whether to post to blocked stock or refuse the delivery. SOP-INB-001 5.3 also requires refusal when outer packaging is damaged but does not distinguish between cases where the product is damaged or intact, creating a direct contradiction with WI-QUA-004 2 and 3.
Notify the QA inspector if the product itself is visibly damaged.

WI-QUA-004 Section 2 requires accepting a delivery if the product is intact despite damaged outer packaging, while SOP-INB-001 Section 5.3 requires refusing the delivery when outer packaging is damaged, regardless of product condition.
